🇲🇽🏥 NEOLIBERALISM: 4,300 HOSPITAL BEDS IN 36 YEARS. THE 4T: 13,300

Sheinbaum laid out the math of neglect: the neoliberal era added just 4,300 hospital beds in 36 years, against 29,500 in the IMSS's first four decades, while the population and chronic disease soared. The 4T has already incorporated 5,708 beds and aims past 13,000 by 2030, with new hospitals, more specialists and the Salud Casa por Casa prevention program. Health care as a right, not a market.

🕊️🇨🇺 "NAME ONE COUNTRY BETTER OFF AFTER A US INVASION"

Cuba's and Iran's ambassadors in Mexico mapped the same playbook for Contralínea: a blockade on Cuba now tightened into an energy siege, with hospitals postponing surgeries; sanctions on its state companies; the kidnapping of Venezuela's president; and the February 28 bombing of Iran that killed over 3,000 people. Cuba takes its case against the blockade back to the UN General Assembly. "We will not surrender. They will not take our happiness."

🇲🇽🎰 3,300 SLOT MACHINES PULLED FROM CARTEL HANDS IN EDOMEX

In a simultaneous sweep across 84 of 125 State of Mexico municipalities, July 13-20, authorities seized over 3,300 slot machines generating 600 million pesos for organized crime — machines used for extortion, "gota a gota" loans and money laundering, planted near schools to hook minors and recruit them. Also seized: 10 to 15 million pesos in cash, still being counted. Hit the money, protect the kids.

🇲🇽🏖️ TULUM REBORN: JAGUAR PARK GOES FREE FOR MEXICANS

Under Plan Tulum Renace, entry to the Parque del Jaguar is now free for national visitors, and the Tulum archaeological zone drops to 80 pesos for Mexicans — free on Sundays — and 265 for foreigners; electric transport inside, 20 pesos. The 10-point plan, agreed with hoteliers and community groups, adds mobility, security and service upgrades. The people's Caribbean, back in the people's hands.

🇲🇽🔥 "ICE, DO YOUR THING": THE TWEET AGAINST MEXICANS, BY A MEXICAN

Sheinbaum called it "unheard of and painful": a Mexican right-winger tagged ICE under footage of her emotional reception by migrants in New York ahead of the World Cup final, inviting raids on his own compatriots — after ICE raids and detention centers have already left 18 Mexican nationals dead. Ricardo Salinas Pliego amplified the post. Her warning stands: whoever bets against Mexico, loses.

🔥🇲🇽 MEXICO TO THE CIA: UNAUTHORIZED AGENTS, OUT

President Sheinbaum revealed that Mexico detected CIA operatives working clandestinely in Chihuahua and formally demanded the US Embassy withdraw them — "and indeed, they left the country." All 250 foreign agents registered in Mexico must be approved by a Security Cabinet committee and report their activities monthly under the National Security Law. Sovereignty is not negotiated; it is enforced, diplomatic note in one hand, Constitution in the other.

🇲🇽🏭 NEARSHORING HOLDS: $4.1 BILLION LANDS IN GUANAJUATO

Even PAN-run Guanajuato makes the nearshoring case: $4.132 billion in foreign investment across 61 projects since September 2024, over 15,000 jobs, and the state now expects to reach 70% of its six-year $8-billion goal by year's end (El Economista). This year alone: $718 million and 4,386 new jobs in auto parts, agro-industry and metalworking — tariffs and all.

🇲🇽✊ MEXICO CITY BRINGS 197,000 DOMESTIC WORKERS OUT OF THE SHADOWS

Mexico City is formalizing a workforce long left informal: 197,000 domestic workers — 91.9% of them women — with only 12,000 currently in the social-security system. The city's labor office gave 2,500 women free legal counsel, ran a mobile "Afiliatón" to enroll them in IMSS, and published an ILO-backed "Guide to Domestic Work with Rights." "Household and care work sustains life," the Women's Ministry noted, "but for decades has disproportionately fallen on women."

🇲🇽🛡️ STATE OF MEXICO HOMICIDES DOWN 58% IN UNDER TWO YEARS

Intentional homicides in the State of Mexico fell 58% from September 2024 to June 2026 — 6.6 daily victims down to 2.8, the lowest average since 2017, per the SESNSP. Vehicle theft dropped 59%, armed robbery of businesses 56%. Security Minister Omar García Harfuch credited the Unified Command "sharing intelligence, planning joint operations and responding more rapidly" across 15 priority municipalities.

🚨🇲🇽 THE PLAYBOOK TO DESTABILIZE MEXICO HAS A GUEST LIST

Contralínea maps the machinery: Larry Rubin — a dual US-Mexican citizen heading the "American Society of Mexico" — hosted a June 6 dinner uniting opposition figures and friendly media, all amplifying the "narco-government" line that invites US intervention. Rubin openly floats a bilateral "crime-fighting treaty" that would put US agents on Mexican soil. Sheinbaum called it out from the podium days later.
